title: Food Transparency
description: BOTIA reads food ingredients and connects what is declared on the label with clear explanations and traceable sources.
home_title_line1: You've read the label a hundred times.
home_title_line2: You still don't know what's in it.
home_description: Scientific evidence. Human language. BOTIA reads the ingredient list and helps you understand what is actually there — without turning the result into a score or deciding for you.
home_jar_note: A familiar label. More context behind it.
home_how_title: Start with the ingredients. Not the barcode.
home_how_intro: BOTIA works from the ingredient list printed on the food. The label is the starting point; the explanation comes after.
home_step1_body: Use the label itself. BOTIA reads the ingredients that are actually declared on the product.
home_step2_body: It identifies ingredients, additives and signals connected to the different BOTIA layers.
home_step3_body: See the explanation, what can be known from the label, what remains uncertain and the sources behind it.
home_you_decide: BOTIA shows you what is there. You decide what matters.
home_explore_intro: The same ingredient list can matter for completely different reasons. BOTIA keeps those questions separate instead of collapsing them into one verdict.
home_woman_desc: Evidence specifically relevant to women, when it exists.
home_animal_desc: What the ingredient list can reveal about animal origin.
home_muslim_desc: Documented halal, haram and doubtful ingredient criteria.
home_sugar_desc: Different names and forms of sugars that are easy to miss.
home_sweeteners_desc: Which sweeteners are present and what they are.
home_flavours_desc: What “flavouring” can mean — and what the label may not tell you.
home_texture_desc: Emulsifiers, thickeners, stabilisers and texture agents.
home_enumbers_desc: Turn a code into an ingredient you can actually understand.
home_evidence_desc: See the documentation behind BOTIA's ingredient information.
home_statement_title: BOTIA doesn't tell you what to eat.
home_statement_body: It shows what is declared, what can be identified from it, what remains uncertain and the evidence behind the information. The choice stays yours.
home_evidence_title: What's in your food — and who says so.
home_evidence_intro: BOTIA connects ingredient information to the documentation behind it. The point is not “trust BOTIA”; the point is that you can see the source.
home_sources_title: Follow the information back to its source
home_sources_body: Ingredient profiles connect explanations to scientific, regulatory and transparency sources instead of hiding the reasoning behind an anonymous score.
home_limits_title: The label has limits. BOTIA keeps them visible.
home_limits_body: If the ingredient list does not reveal origin, manufacturing practice or something that happened before the product reached the shelf, BOTIA should not pretend that it knows.
home_label_limit_title: BOTIA reads the label — not the company behind it.
home_label_limit_body: It can analyse what is written there and explain the information connected to those ingredients. It cannot infer company practices, animal testing or other facts that are not present on the label.
home_final_kicker: Try it on a real label
home_final_title: Scan the label. See what's there. See the evidence. You decide.
home_final_body: Don't take our word for it. Photograph an ingredient list and see what BOTIA finds.
